title: Tuesday celebrity night at the DeLisa
summary: He introduced celebrity night, when visiting stars like Charlie Ventura, Shelly Manne, Louis Armstrong and Lionel Hampton played for the crowd.

Yeah, and on Tuesday night, I would -- I introduced it as celebrity night for them out there, and each Tuesday we'd invite whomever was in town, like, that time, Charlie Ventura when he had his little group.
Yeah, oh, yeah, with Benny Green, and all of that.

Yeah, and what's his name, Roy -- Kral. (Simultaneous discussion-- unintelligible.) Right, right, and then we'd have Louis Armstrong, and they'd come out and we could just turn the joint out. Boy, it was really something.
